exposure: temporary transcatheter balloon occlusion of bilateral internal iliac arteries (TBOIIA)
outcome: Rate of uterine artery embolization (UAE) and hysterectomy
cohort: 62 patients with placenta previa and a high risk of massive hemorrhage
finding: Planned cesarean section with TBOIIA in a hybrid OR is effective in reducing intraoperative blood loss, ensuring safe placental removal, and conserving the uterus in patients with placenta previa and a high risk of massive hemorrhage.
